projectDescription: A cross-platform ebook manager and reader with support for 15+ formats, cloud sync, AI features, and self-hosting via Docker for Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iOS, and Web.
keyFeatures: Supports 15+ ebook formats including EPUB, PDF, MOBI, AZW3, FB2, CBZ, DOCX, Markdown, HTML, and more
Cross-platform: Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iOS, and Web
Cloud sync and backup with OneDrive, Google Drive, Dropbox, MEGA, WebDAV, FTP, SFTP, S3-compatible storage, and more
Text-to-speech with plugin support for custom voices
Annotations: bookmarks, highlights, notes with export
Fully customizable reading experience: fonts, layouts, themes, brightness
Plugin system for extending TTS, AI, and other capabilities
Self-hosting via Docker with built-in HTTP server
publicApiSurface: Book model (key, name, author, format, cover, md5, path, charset)
Plugin model (type, script, config, langList, voiceList)
SyncService.getSyncUtil() — get configured cloud sync utility
SyncService.getPickerUtil(service) — get file picker for a cloud service
backup(name) — backup library to local or cloud storage
restore(name) — restore library from local or cloud storage
updateUserConfig(config) — update user configuration on server
TTSUtil.readAloud(currentIndex) — play TTS audio for a segment
Docker HTTP server on port 8080 with configurable username/password
